checks.name: Select touch Push-to-talk without a hardware key
checks.observation: The PTT selector changed from Voice Activity to Push-to-talk without requesting a key binding. Audio settings displayed the touch-hold instruction and the voice dock exposed a hold-to-talk control.

checks.name: Microphone capture while touch is held
checks.observation: During an ADB-injected touch hold, Android AudioService reported an active, unsilenced VOICE_COMMUNICATION recording for the app. No speech was played into the emulator.

checks.name: Microphone capture stops on release
checks.observation: After the touch pointer was released, AudioService reported Recording active: false and recorded the AudioRecord stop event.

checks.name: Restore test state
checks.observation: Voice Activity was restored. The client remained in the voice room with its microphone muted.

limitations: Emulator-only validation; active AudioRecord does not prove that intelligible audio reached a remote participant.
System interruptions, app backgrounding while held, pointer cancellation, physical-device behavior, and TalkBack/VoiceOver remain untested.
remaining: Validate touch cancellation and accessibility behavior on physical Android/iOS; use a paired receiver if end-to-end audio delivery must be accepted.
